About Position:




We are seeking an experienced Backend Engineer with strong expertise in Python to design and build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. The role focuses on developing APIs, managing data workflows, and building automation through cron jobs while ensuring clean, modular, and maintainable code. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with frontend, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to deliver robust, production-ready applications in a fast-paced environment.



Role: Backend Engineer
Location: All PSL
Experience: 5 to 8 years
Job Type: Full Time Employment



What You'll Do:



Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and services using Python
Build and manage RESTful APIs and integrate them with frontend and external systems
Develop and maintain cron jobs and automation scripts to support business workflows
Ensure high-quality code through testing, debugging, and peer reviews
Work with relational and NoSQL databases to design efficient data models and queries
Implement scalable and secure backend solutions following best practices
Collaborate with frontend, DevOps, and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms such as Google Cloud (Compute Engine, GCS)
Containerize applications using Docker and ensure consistency across environments
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability
Participate in Agile processes including sprint planning, code reviews, and daily stand-ups
Troubleshoot production issues and drive root cause analysis and resolution
Maintain documentation for development, deployment, and system processes
Suggest enhancements to improve system performance, security, and maintainability



Expertise You'll Bring:



5-8 years of strong hands-on experience in Python development
Experience with frameworks such as Flask or Django
Strong knowledge of RESTful API design and integration
Proficiency in working with RDBMS and NoSQL databases
Strong experience in Bash scripting and automation tasks
Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized application deployment
Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (Compute Engine, GCS) or similar cloud platforms
Understanding of data structures, object-oriented programming, and functional programming concepts
Experience with Git and modern development workflows
Strong debugging, performance optimization, and problem-solving skills
Ability to write clean, secure, well-documented, and maintainable code
Familiarity with MVC/MVVM architectural patterns
Good understanding of frontend technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript) is a plus
Experience with CI/CD practices and microservices architecture is an advantage
Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively



Benefits:



Competitive salary and benefits package
Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
Annual health check-ups
Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents



Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.



We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please nform us during the application process or at any time during your employment



Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent.com/careers




"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."
